summary: Full verification of /priser rewrite: single-page consolidation of monthly+yearly, new cancellation policy, cleaner tier grid, Stripe integration end-to-end. All 12 requirements from the review request PASS on desktop and mobile. Fresh user registration → Stripe checkout with both lookup_keys returns real checkout.stripe.com URLs. No regressions on /manifest, /eksempler, /etikk, /.

PASS: ORDINÆR shows both prices — 'Månedlig 149 kr/mnd' and 'Årlig 1290 kr/år' stacked vertically
PASS: SPAR 498 KR badge visible at top-left of yearly button (absolute -top-2.5 left-4, moss bg, white text)

PASS: No dead code compile errors — FOUNDER const removed, cycle state removed, Tier helper removed; only REGULAR const remains. Page renders cleanly with no console errors (401s from /billing/status are expected auth-gated pings)
PASS: Regression — /manifest, /eksempler, /etikk, / all return 200 with correct titles
PASS: Anon user clicking price → redirects to /logg-inn (correct auth guard)
PASS: Mobile viewport (390x844) — all 3 buttons (BETA, monthly, yearly) visible; cards stack vertically as expected
